title: OTHRYS OS evidence-derived phase display
goal: Derive the visible Plan/Build/Review/Ship phase display from mission and result evidence instead of static UI state, without granting transition authority.
laws: Plan is complete only when a mission envelope exists.
Build remains active while the current mission has no result file.
Review may be shown complete only from a PASS result; it is never inferred from builder claims.
Ship/closeout is distinct from candidate verification and must not be implied by a PASS result alone.
Phase display is read-only projection, not a state-transition engine.
Approval and evidence remain separate fields.
No new transition, write, routing, shell, execution, accept, reject, release, Hephaestus, Talos or Worker authority.
